lines.text: *Thud*
*Thud thud thud*
*Whoosh*
The elevator doors open.
The Commander stands before her, sweat pouring down. The soldier holds him steady from behind.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: ... You're unbelievable!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: You're going down to the Ark.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Live, Commander.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Don't be ridiculous! Do you really think I could live with myself if I did that?

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Lilith! What do you take me for?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: If you stay here, you'll die! You know that.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: So what?

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Dying doesn't scare me! I...

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: I'll die with all of you!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: And what about the girls?! What are they supposed to do?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Go! Go to the Ark. Take responsibility and make sure the girls get there safely too!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: You're the only one who can save them!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: It has to be you!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Take care of them, Commander!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: I can't! I won't leave you behind!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Andersen!!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: You know what's gonna happen!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: They'll be left behind on the surface!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Please...

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: The girls...

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: You have to save them.
Andersen begins to waver.
The soldier grabs him from behind again and locks him in place.
His eyes meet Liliweiss', and she gives a nod.
The elevator doors start to close.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Let go! Let go of me! I said let go!

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Lilith! Lilith! I...

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I didn't even get to say goodbye...
The elevator doors close,
leaving only a thin slit.
Andersen peers through the narrow gap at a white flower that appears on the verge of wilting.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Lilith, I love you.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I love you too, Andersen.
*Whoosh*
The elevator doors close,
and it begins to descend.
Lilith stands frozen,
tears streaming down her face.
She walks on,
passing by the entrance to the Ark,
and heads for a vantage point overlooking the battlefield.
Through her clouded vision, she vaguely makes out the figures of her cherished subordinates, comrades, and friends.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Ah...
On the battlefield, she sees them.
A young lady moving with unparalleled grace.
A compassionate saint wreathed in gold.
A swordswoman whose movements flow like water.
And a speck of spotless, pure white.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Only one mass-produced Heretic left.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: ... Who mightst thou be?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Reinforcements...? Who could be arriving now, of all times?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: No way...

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: It's me, Snow White.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... Snow White?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Risen from the grave, have we?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Those parts... What are they?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I used Rapture parts as temporary components.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Have you... gone through a Mind Switch?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: So your memories...

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Dorothy, Scarlet, Rapunzel.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Let's move. We can talk later.
Snow White breaks into a run,
as Dorothy, Scarlet and Rapunzel follow.
They clash with the mass-produced Heretic.
The dust begins to settle.
Liliweiss, certain of victory, sits back against a wall.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: ... You're all grown up.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I'm so proud of you.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Haha...

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I really am.
Her eyelids grow heavy.
Even as her eyes begin to close, she strains to look at her friends a little longer.
Then, with a smile,
she quietly closes her eyes.
The white flower withers,
and the Goddess of Victory falls asleep.
Three hours later.
Freesia stares at the crowd ahead.
The once large crowd has diminished to only a few people.
She looks back.
There's no one else.
A soldier at the elevator entrance keeps shouting.
This might be the last call.
The people ahead start walking and step into the elevator.
Freesia grows anxious as her distance from the person ahead of her grows.
She looks back.
Still no one.
She fidgets with the folded paper against her chest.
Keenly aware of the paper she holds, she walks with her eyes fixated on the ground.
She walks slowly. Very slowly.
The soldier at the front keeps shouting, urging her to hurry.
Freesia pretends not to hear and keeps walking slowly.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: You should look where you're going.
She looks back.

lines.speaker: freesia
lines.text: Mister!

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Where did the soldier go?

lines.speaker: freesia
lines.text: He was with me. But everyone looked so busy, so I told him to help them.

lines.speaker: freesia
lines.text: I can go alone.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Can you?

lines.speaker: freesia
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: We won't be seeing each other often.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Are you okay with that?

lines.speaker: freesia
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: All right, let's go then.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: To the Ark.
The elevator doors close.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Lilith! Lilith!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Li...lith... no... No!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... Scarlet.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Why the long face?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Could you... make her a coffin?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Aye, I shall prepare it using the finest white stone I can find.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... Snow White.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Who is she?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You don't remember.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: ... No, I don't.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: But... why are you crying?
Snow White lifts a hand to her cheek.
Tears are falling.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I don't know. What's happening?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: So, who is she? Someone significant?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... The Goddess of Victory.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: That's who she was.
OPERATION ARK GUARDIAN: END
One month later.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: What's the latest?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Same as usual. No one today.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Not a soul has arrived since that fateful day.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Neither human, nor Nikke.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: We've had some Nikkes stop by... but not a single human.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Maybe... maybe there really aren't any survivors...

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... Let's wait a little longer.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: What about the Commander?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Still no word. Some of the mass-produced units said they saw him heading down to the Ark, so he's probably there.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Given his condition, his recovery might be a long one.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Perchance, he is no longer among us.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: What say they from within the Ark?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: They say the Ark will be completely sealed in four months.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: After that, they'll open the emergency gate to come and retrieve us.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: So they send word still, do they?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Yes... albeit through a recorded voice message.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Raptures incoming.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Roger.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Everyone, get ready.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: How tiresome this is.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Just hang in there a little longer.
Another month passes.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Any word?
Dorothy shakes her head.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: He's perchance at his drink again.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You've been drinking too much lately.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: No more than a sip.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: If a Heretic shows up, even a mass-produced one, we're finished.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Two months hence, and still no whisper of them...

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Perchance the last we felled was the last of their kind.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I wouldn't be so sure.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You're far too optimistic.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Better that than clutching ever at the dread they might return.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... You may be right to think that way.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Aye, sometimes one must delude oneself out of necessity.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Still, try to keep your wits about you.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I shall bear it in mind.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Raptures incoming.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Just a handful.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Phew...

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: When will this end...
Another month later.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: How are the mass-produced Nikkes doing?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Things have gone from bad to worse since their squad leader got corrupted.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Let me say a quick prayer.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Call me if anything happens.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Rapunzel.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: It's nothing. I appreciate what you're doing.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Don't mention it.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Snow White.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Nothing out of the ordinary so far.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: No, what I meant is, are you all right?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Nothing out of the ordinary so far.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I shall step out for a moment.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You're going out? Where to?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: My spirits have run dry. I shall fetch more.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Now's not the time for that!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: All right, fine. Be careful.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Aye, I shall return.

lines.speaker: collectrobot
lines.text: Do you wish to contact the Ark?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Affirmative.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: collectrobot
lines.text: Communication open. All recorded messages will be transmitted to the Ark.

lines.speaker: collectrobot
lines.text: However, in the event of poor signal, transmission may fail.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: This is Dorothy, acting leader of the Goddess Squad. I have assumed this position due to the death of our former leader, Major Lilith.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Our current situation is as follows.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Our mission is to protect those who have been deemed important and escort them from the surface to the massive underground facility known as the Ark.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Operation: Ark Guardian is approximately 72% complete.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: There are officially no more humans remaining on the surface.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: The Goddess Squad and several mass-produced Nikkes are stationed at temporary outposts situated at the Ark's entrance.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: We are to protect the entrance against any future Rapture raids until the Ark is completed and sealed off.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: It is expected that we will be required to do this for approximately two months.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: However, the situation is becoming dire.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Our resources and troops are both slowly being depleted, and we are becoming physically drained due to the incessant fighting.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: We do not expect any form of backup from the Ark.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: We will do everything in our power to succeed.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: In exchange for this, you must promise us one thing.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Once the city has been sealed, we are to be taken back to the Ark,

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: where we will be regarded as Goddess of Victory.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Make us feel proud for continuing to fight for humanity.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: That is all. I will be waiting for your answer.

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: It would be best to abandon the Heretic program, which relied on mass-produced human imposters.

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: The base bodies and personalities are incomplete, leading to worse outcomes than doing nothing. The process is overly complicated.

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: ... I wonder if something like Anachiro can ever be made again.

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: Every now and then, a human imposter emerges with a sense of self that is remarkably complete,

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: but such occurrences are exceedingly rare.
*Bubble bubble*

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: Which is precisely why my expectations for you are so high.

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: I wanted to see what would happen if we created a Heretic from a human imposter with a strong sense of self.

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: It's also the second work Mother designed.

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: Come into being. You will play a crucial role.

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: You will deliver the "head" to our mother, who drifts alone above us.

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: Oh, I can't wait to see you soon.
*Bubble bubble*

lines.speaker: mirror
lines.text: Liberalio.
Oswald goes over the minutes dozens of times.
They concern follow-up actions regarding Operation Ark Guardian and the sealing of the Ark.
Operation Ark Guardian was a great success.
The Ark's seal remains unstable.
It must be finished using the forces left on the surface.
The Goddess Squad is still active and continues to provide updates.
The task of finalizing the sealing process will be assigned to the Goddess Squad.
Oswald is the best fit for this final operation.
Regarding the handling of the Goddess Squad upon their return:
Their arrival in the Ark poses significant risks,
including idolization and the potential for deification.
Their reputation and prestige are likely to greatly surpass those of the Central Government.
Given the instability of the current situation, the risk is exceptionally high.
The same protocol used for second-generation traitors may be applicable.
Charges of collusion with Raptures may potentially be imposed. Relevant documentation has been prepared.
Red Shoes' corruption research can be transferred under Rapunzel's name. V.T.C. is fully on board.
Regarding the plan to execute the Goddess Squad at the Ark entrance under the pretext of corruption,
Enikk is uncooperative. Armed suppression involves significant risks and may likely expose the plan to the public.
Political and social erasure is the most effective method.
The Commander of the Goddess Squad is a risk factor.
He is currently comatose and being monitored by V.T.C.
The other witnesses who rode the elevator with him have been eliminated. Not a single soul knows the Commander survived.
The Goddess Squad has no backing. Political and social erasure is feasible.
Lifelong house arrest and isolation are appropriate and ideal.
The technology used in the Grimms model is of the highest quality and includes valuable battle data.
Dismantling and subsequent research are among the considerations.
Conclusion:
Initiate the final phase of the Ark sealing operation with the Goddess Squad.
Upon their return,
dispose of them in a manner that does not provoke the citizens.
Oswald fights the urge to hurl his phone.
He covers his face.
After a moment,
a resolve settles over him.
The thought of his upcoming plan makes him feel nauseous,
but he must see it through.
They must remain as idols.
Forever.
Oswald looks at the picture frame on the table.
It is a photo commemorating the Goddess Squad's first deployment.
With a weary motion, he salutes the photo.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: My deepest gratitude to the Goddess Squad,

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: who fought for humanity.
Snow White opens her eyes.
Her body feels light.
It seems she has adapted to her body.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_r
lines.text: You up?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_r
lines.text: I've finished calibrating your armaments.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_r
lines.text: Let's get you suited up.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: I'm heading to the hangar.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_r
lines.text: I'll meet you there.
*Beep*
Snow White sits up
and looks in the mirror.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: ... Tear stains.
She leaves the room
and walks down the corridor,
stopping before she reaches the hangar.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: Lilith...
Snow White opens the door to the hangar.
ARK GUARDIAN: END
